verse.verse_4: By no means! anon they shall know.
verse.verse_5: Again, by no means! anon they shall know.
verse.verse_6: Have We not made the earth an expanse.
verse.verse_8: And We have created you in pairs.
verse.verse_9: And We have made your sleep as a rest.
verse.verse_10: And We have made the night a covering.
verse.verse_11: And We have made the day for seeking livelihood.
verse.verse_12: And We have builded over you seven strong heavens.
verse.verse_13: And We have set therein lamps glowing.
verse.verse_14: And We have sent down from the rain-clouds water plenteous.
verse.verse_15: So that We bring forth thereby corn and vegetation.
verse.verse_17: Verily the Day of Decision is a time appointed.
verse.verse_18: It is a Day whereon the trumpet will be blown, and ye will come in multitudes.
verse.verse_19: And the heaven will have been opened, and it will have become doors.
verse.verse_20: And the mountains will have been removed away, and they will have become as mirage.
verse.verse_21: Verily the Hell is an ambuscade:
verse.verse_23: They will tarry therein for ages.
verse.verse_24: They will not taste therein cool or any drink.
verse.verse_27: Verily they were wont not to look for a reckoning.
verse.verse_28: And they belied Our revelations with strong belying.
verse.verse_29: And everything We have recorded in a book.
verse.verse_30: Taste therefore. We shall not increase you in aught but torment.
verse.verse_31: Verily for the God-fearing is an achievement.
verse.verse_33: And full-breasted maidens of equal age.
verse.verse_35: They will hear therein no babble nor falsehood:
verse.verse_36: A recompense from thy Lord-a gift sufficient -
verse.verse_37: From the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatsoever is in bet-ween them, the Compassionate with Whom they can demand not audience.
verse.verse_38: On the Day whereon the spirits and the angels will stand arrayed, they will not be able to speak save him whom the Compassionate giveth leave and who speaketh aright.
verse.verse_39: That is the Sure Day. Whosoever therefore willeth, let him betake Unto his Lord a resort.
verse.verse_40: Verily We! We have warned you of a torment nigh at hand, a Day whereon a man shall behold that which his hands have sent forth, and the infidel will say: would that I were dust!
